substack.email_subject: He reads everything. Then he throws almost all of it away.
substack.note:
Twice a year, Bill Gates disappears: no phone, no staff, just a cabin on the Washington coast and a locked case of paper. By the end of the week, most of it will never be mentioned again.

The value was never in reading more than everyone else. It was in being willing to throw almost all of it away.
